reason: I’ll follow the only available action to introduce the scrape and see how the body responds.

effect: The scrape breaks the skin barrier and tiny vessels, so I expect a local response to limit the leak.
reaction: The clarification that these components already belong to the body makes the setup clearer.
reason: Platelets are the only offered combination, and they seem relevant to limiting bleeding.
expectation: I expect platelets to gather at the damaged vessels and help begin a plug, though clotting proteins may also be needed.

effect: The platelet plug limits the leak, but the missing skin still needs repair.
reaction: The distinction between stopping the leak and rebuilding skin is clear.
reason: Clotting proteins are the only offered combination and may reinforce the plug.
expectation: I expect the proteins to help stabilize the plug and further limit bleeding, though I am unsure how the game will represent that.

effect: The fibrin mesh reinforces the platelet plug, and the next goal is to prepare the site for rebuilding.
reaction: The temporary seal makes the difference between stopping a leak and repairing skin clear.
reason: Cleanup cells are the only offered combination and seem suited to preparing the damaged site.
expectation: I expect the cells to clear debris from the damaged area, though I’m unsure what else they will do.

effect: Cleanup cells prepare the site by dealing with debris and microbes and signaling repair; the tissue is still not rebuilt.
reaction: I was surprised that defense, cleanup and rebuilding overlap, even though the chapter ends before rebuilding.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding clotting proteins was most worthwhile because the fibrin mesh showed how the platelet plug is reinforced while making clear that a seal is not rebuilt skin.

leastWorthwhile.text: Introducing the scrape was the least engaging step: it set up the situation, but the only available action made the choice feel routine.

surprise.text: The cleanup cells also send signals that influence repair, connecting defense and rebuilding rather than treating them as entirely separate stages.

arbitrary.text: No action seemed arbitrary; each had a stated role, although every decision offered only one combination.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the living skin is rebuilt. The distinction between a temporary seal and a restored barrier leaves a clear question, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
